SSR off-cycle invariant (every non-zero `ssr_off_cycle_arr` row must satisfy): `(is_superseded AND is_early_termination) OR (is_superseding AND NOT has_related_bb_product AND NOT term_end_in_quarter AND arr_category IN ('Net New','Add On','Expansion','Contraction'))`. Cite this as the validation rule for any spec that touches SSR / agreement renewal. Business meaning: superseding agreement where the old agreements it replaced had `term_end_in_quarter=TRUE` but `agreement_end_date` NOT in that quarter - the replacement happened BEFORE the old agreements' natural expiry, so it's an off-cycle SSR rather than a clean renewal.
evidence: Refactored QA / UAT Testing - canonical SSR off-cycle rule, posted multiple times.

lesson: `is_renewing_agreement` MUST include `term_start_in_quarter` in its predicate. Omitting it (a frequent refactor regression) shifts ARR from `up_for_renewal` to `off_cycle` for all superseding agreements after the start quarter. Flag any spec or PR that touches renewal logic without explicitly mentioning `term_start_in_quarter` for clarifier follow-up.

lesson: ED&A intake requires, before building any new field: (1) a business use case, (2) complete input mapping (e.g. a full UOM->bucket table), and (3) a NAMED owner of the logic. Do not start implementation until all three exist.

FSE vs Non-FSE must be derived from PRODUCT_PRICING_UOM (source/product-master field), NOT the Sigma 'Unit of Measure' text array. FSE UOMs: FSE, Seat(s), Planning/Sourcing/Learning Seats, FTE, Employees, Users. Exception: Product Name = 'Support Services' is ALWAYS FSE regardless of UOM. Everything else = Non-FSE.

Acquisition-Standalone should be derived from Reltio 'Source Entity' (product code with entity source != 'Workday' and != 'B2B'), NOT per-acquisition hard-coded lists. Legacy logic hard-codes each acquisition in 4-5 places and silently breaks (Evisort/HiredScore = FALSE incorrectly). Product names/SKU mappings are owned in Reltio by Product (Esther) - ED&A does not rename SKUs.

SCOPE RULE (IA project only): Only ever analyze, modify, or reason about code that is part of the IA / data-mesh project. Restrict all work to the finance_line_analytics (FLA) end-to-end flow: FLA itself, the SOURCE models/functions that feed FLA, and every upstream and downstream dependency of FLA inside finance_prod / finance_int_prod. NEVER consider legacy or non-IA code - certified_* databases, bt_* / bv_* models, or any model outside the IA project. If a request or lineage points at non-IA code, stop and re-scope to the FLA IA lineage, and flag the out-of-scope reference.
